versions.content: The Dem shall use the DemDtrUpdateKind for the evaluation and processing of reported DTR -values: • DEM_DTR_UPDATE_ALWAYS : State of the event is not considered (default, and used if DemDtrEventRef is not configured). • DEM_DTR_UPDATE_STEADY : Only when the events pre-debouncing within Dem is stuck at the FAIL or PASS limit, and the latest result matches the debouncing direction.
